description: S-2E c/n 297C, ex USN BuNo 152828 (VS-31, VS-38), shipped to Argentina October 1995 as spares source 0860/2-AS-27 and never flown locally; trucked from Bahía Blanca 17 May 2024, restored by Luján veterans and inaugurated at its intersection site 22 November 2025. Photographed November 2025.
museum_name: Grumman Tracker Veteranos de Malvinas Monument, Luján
